state_machine.description: Fresh FB instance before the first scan. Outputs and previousValue hold declared initial values.

actions: transition unconditionally to RUN for first-scan edge computation
do not update previousValue before computing rising/falling masks

state_machine.description: Normal per-scan operation. The FB samples value and reports per-scan edge masks, flags, and counts.

actions: compute risingBits and fallingBits from sampled value and retained previousValue
update previousValue := value after edge masks are computed

priorities: Safety: compute both edge masks from the current sampled value and the retained previousValue before updating previousValue.
Safety: use full 32-bit DWORD bitwise operations; do not truncate to 16 bits. Counts must remain in 0..32.
Safety: rising and falling masks are mutually exclusive per bit in the same scan: (risingBits AND fallingBits) = 0.
Operational: outputs are per-scan pulse values, not latched. Recompute every scan from value and previousValue.
Operational: flags are derived from masks and value change; hasChanged is true iff value <> previousValue.
Operational: no timers or CASE/IF-gated timer calls. The FB is deterministic and combinational per scan except for previousValue memory.
Operational: no explicit reset input. Initialization occurs only at FB instance creation/initial observation.

scan_execution_order.name: edge sampling
scan_execution_order.details: Sample the current input port value once into sampledValue. Do not update previousValue in this stage.

scan_execution_order.name: safety/reset priority & state transitions
scan_execution_order.details: Apply no external reset. If in INIT, transition unconditionally to RUN after preserving the fresh-instance initial observation. In RUN, remain in RUN. Safety rule: previousValue is not updated here.

scan_execution_order.name: unconditional top-level timer FB calls outside CASE/IF
scan_execution_order.details: No timer FBs are required or called by this FB. If timers were present, all top-level timer FB calls would be placed here unconditionally, outside CASE/IF.

scan_execution_order.name: unified output assignments
scan_execution_order.details: Compute risingBits := value AND (NOT previousValue); fallingBits := previousValue AND (NOT value); noOfRisingBits := popcount(risingBits); noOfFallingBits := popcount(fallingBits); hasRisingEdges := risingBits <> 0; hasFallingEdges := fallingBits <> 0; hasChanged := value <> previousValue. Assign all declared outputs exactly once. After both edge masks are computed and outputs are assigned, update previousValue := value.
